sources.title: GitHub Pages - InternVL
sources.snippet: 🚀 [NEW!] We release the InternVL 2.5, an advanced multimodal large language model (MLLM) series with parameter coverage ranging from 1B to 78B. InternVL2_5-78B is the first open-source MLLMs to achieve over 70% on the MMMU benchmark, matching the performance of leading closed-source commercial models like GPT-4o. We release the InternVL2 series.
